snippet.title: Essence Of The Tjikko - Remaster Edition
snippet.description:
🌿 Essence of the Tjikko – Official Remaster Trailer

A botanical Zelda-like born from 6 years of solo development.

Awaken as a hybrid plant child in an underground lab. Climb 7 floors toward sunlight. Transform through the seasons — Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter — each with unique powers. Wall-climb, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of your origin.

✨ Now rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5
🎵 Original soundtrack by Philippe Reinhart
🌱 Free demo available on Steam

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783740

#IndieGame #Zelda40th #BotanicalAdventure #UnrealEngine5 #IndieDev
